name: highlighter
blurb: Text marked with hand-drawn styled annotations (highlight, underline, box, circle, etc.).
description: Wraps text with animated rough-notation overlays. Supports multiple annotation styles: highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through, crossed-off, and bracket. Animations draw on scroll visibility or immediately.
use_when: Inline text needs a playful, hand-drawn highlight or underline effect.
avoid_when: When annotations must be crisp and precise rather than sketchy.
a11y: Text is fully readable; annotations are visual overlays.
